verdict.rationale: DeepInfra's first-party models documentation describes a model deprecation policy with 'at least 1 week's advance notice before the deprecation date'. After deprecation, requests are automatically forwarded to a recommended replacement, and developers can pin model versions. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that notices are actually sent, a published deprecations list or changelog (deprecations.md and changelog.md return 404), and the one-week minimum notice is short.

support.subject: As a developer, I can rely on a documented deprecation policy with advance notice before a hosted model is removed

citations.quote: You'll receive at least 1 week's advance notice before the deprecation date
Your applications won't break — after deprecation, inference requests are automatically forwarded to a recommended replacement model
